name: HARPA AI
tagline: Page-aware AI agent in your browser — summarize, automate, extract.
description: A browser extension that turns any web page into a workspace for a multi-model AI agent. It reads the page you're on to summarize articles, YouTube videos and PDFs, draft and reply to email, proofread, generate content, and scrape or monitor sites. A library of prebuilt commands plus visual automation lets it click, fill forms and export results, and it connects to Zapier, Make and n8n for longer workflows.
insight: Built in Finland; ISO 27001-certified and runs its web automation locally in the browser rather than on a server.

modelSupport.notes: Use the built-in CloudGPT or bring your own API key across providers.

edge: Page-aware browser agent with 100+ prebuilt commands and visual web automation across GPT, Claude, Gemini and Perplexity — without leaving the tab.
pros: Reads the current page for grounded answers
100+ prebuilt commands out of the box
Visual automation: clicks, forms, CSV export
Connects to Zapier, Make and n8n
Bring your own key across providers
cons: Higher quotas and multi-model gated behind paid plans
Page automation can break when sites change

references.title: Learn about Harpa: the AI automation agent for Chrome
